character_bible: LION: A majestic, friendly male lion with warm golden-yellow fur, a magnificent fluffy amber-brown mane, large expressive amber-gold eyes, a soft pinkish-brown nose, and oversized, padded paws. Built sturdy and grand yet gentle and approachable for young children. MOUSE: A tiny, adorable woodland mouse with soft velvety warm-gray fur, a creamy white belly, oversized rounded pink ears, shiny black button eyes, a twitching tiny pink nose, and a thin, expressive tail. Dressed in no human clothes, purely natural animal design styled for a charming storybook.

pages.heading: 쿨쿨 잠든 사자와 작은 생쥐
pages.text: 따스한 햇살이 비치는 숲속 커다란 나무 아래에서 사자가 곤히 낮잠을 자고 있었어요. 그때 작고 귀여운 생쥐가 깡충깡충 지나가다 그만 사자의 둥그런 코를 밟고 말았어요.
pages.scene_prompt: Children's storybook illustration style. A massive golden-furred lion sleeping peacefully under a grand oak tree with dappled sunlight filtering through lush green leaves. A tiny warm-gray mouse with large pink ears accidentally leaps right across the sleeping lion's big nose. Peaceful, warm, whimsical atmosphere, soft watercolor and colored pencil textures.

pages.heading: 저를 살려주세요!
pages.text: 잠에서 깬 사자는 커다란 앞발로 작은 생쥐를 덥석 잡았어요. 깜짝 놀란 생쥐는 두 손을 모아 빌었어요. "사자님, 저를 놓아주시면 언젠가 꼭 은혜를 갚을게요!"
pages.scene_prompt: Low-angle close-up illustration. The golden lion is now awake, looking down with wide surprised amber eyes. His giant soft padded paw rests gently over the tiny gray mouse on the mossy ground. The little mouse stands on two hind legs with tiny paws pressed together in an earnest begging pose. Soft, non-threatening, storybook framing.

pages.heading: 너그러운 사자의 웃음
pages.text: 사자는 조그만 생쥐가 자기를 돕겠다는 말에 껄껄 웃음이 났어요. "하하, 쬐그만 네가 날 돕는다고?" 마음씨 착한 사자는 너그럽게 발을 치워 생쥐를 안전하게 보내주었어요.
pages.scene_prompt: Medium shot of the lion sitting upright, chuckling heartily with a friendly open-mouthed smile and twinkling eyes. He gracefully lifts his huge paw into the air, gesturing for the mouse to run free. The tiny mouse scampers away happily along green moss, glancing back over its shoulder with gratitude.

pages.heading: 그물에 걸린 숲속의 왕
pages.text: 며칠 뒤, 숲속을 걷던 사자가 사냥꾼이 숨겨놓은 질긴 밧줄 그물에 꽁꽁 갇히고 말았어요. 사자는 빠져나오지 못해 숲이 쩌렁쩌렁 울리도록 크게 울부짖었어요.
pages.scene_prompt: Dynamic wide-angle shot in a denser, shadowy part of the forest. The majestic golden lion is trapped inside a heavy brown hemp rope net tied to surrounding thick tree trunks. The lion throws his head back, letting out a desperate roar with sound waves rustling forest leaves. Dramatic yet child-friendly tension.

pages.heading: 갉작갉작, 은혜를 갚는 생쥐
pages.text: 사자의 큰 목소리를 알아들은 생쥐가 쪼르르 달려왔어요. 생쥐는 단단한 밧줄을 날카로운 앞니로 갉작갉작 갉기 시작했어요. 마침내 툭 하고 굵은 밧줄이 끊어졌지요.
pages.scene_prompt: Extreme close-up macro shot focusing on the determined tiny mouse. The mouse vigorously gnaws on a thick, coarse hemp rope, fibers fraying and snapping under its tiny sharp teeth. In the soft-focus background, the tangled lion watches with hopeful, astonished eyes. Warm lighting on the mouse's heroic effort.

pages.heading: 다시 찾은 자유와 따뜻한 마음
pages.text: 그물에서 풀려난 사자는 뛸 듯이 기뻤어요. 생쥐가 으쓱하며 말했어요. "사자님, 작은 생쥐도 은혜를 갚을 수 있지요?" 사자와 생쥐는 서로를 보며 다정하게 웃었답니다.
pages.scene_prompt: Warm, joyful golden hour wide shot in a sunny forest clearing. The freed lion lies down happily on the grass with his head low to the ground, smiling lovingly at the tiny mouse who stands proudly on a mossy pebble right before his face. Beautiful glowing sunbeams, fluttering butterflies, celebrating an unlikely friendship.

parent_moral: 큰 사자도 작은 생쥐의 도움을 받았지요. 몸집이나 힘이 다르다고 누구의 마음과 능력을 작게 보아서는 안 돼요. 우리도 서로에게 고마운 마음을 전하고, 도움이 필요할 때 기꺼이 손을 내밀어 보아요.
